versions.changelog:
industrial-anomaly-detector 1.1.0

- Initial release of the industrial-anomaly-detector skill based on anomalib 2.3.3
- Supports industrial visual anomaly detection for uploaded product images
- Returns both detection results and anomaly heatmaps
- Integrates 20+ anomaly detection models; default support for Patchcore, Padim, EfficientAd
- Provides modular API for single image and batch processing, model training, and export
- Includes environment setup guide and example references for quick start
